limits.scenarioCplusD: NOT demonstrated live. An idle thread emits ~2 stream items, none carrying a sequence number this probe could find, so there were no server-issued sequences to classify. The classifier is unit-tested (6 tests: contiguous, empty, late-start gap, mid-range hole, snapshot gap, gap-distinct-from-empty) but those use synthetic sequences. Demonstrating it live needs an active agent turn generating a real event stream, which is Phase 3 work.

summary.note: Three states, not a boolean. 'demonstrated', 'not-demonstrated' and 'failed' are different facts, and an earlier version of this file collapsed the last two into allScenariosPassed:false with a prose note explaining the difference. A boolean plus documentation is a boolean plus a thing nobody reads.
